name: German Rice Waffles

instructions.text: Boil half a pound of rice in milk until it becomes thoroughly soft

Remove it from the fire, stirring it constantly, and adding, a little at a time, one quart of sifted flour, five beaten eggs, two spoonfuls of yeast, a half pound of melted butter, a little salt and a teacupful of warm milk

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil half a pound of rice in milk until it becomes thoroughly soft
2. Remove it from the fire, stirring it constantly, and adding, a little at a time, one quart of sifted flour, five beaten eggs, two spoonfuls of yeast, a half pound of melted butter, a little salt and a teacupful of warm milk
3. Set the batter in a warm place, and, when risen, bake in the ordinary way
